title: Feature Development Lifecycle SOP — Internal Operational Distillation (desensitized)
provenance: Desensitized SOP mined from the host user's development session logs across multiple projects. Patterns only: no project names, no conversation excerpts, no filesystem paths.

claims.text: The high-frequency real development chain is longer than mid-task playbooks assume: it runs specify -> dispatch -> impl-audit -> converge -> acceptance -> release, and skipping the specify stage correlates with rework loops later.
Spec co-design review by heterogeneous (non-host-family) runners before implementation catches spec errors and omissions that same-family self-review misses.
Convergence without test-pins is illusory: invariants raised by adversarial audit that are not turned into regression tests resurface as drift in later sessions.
A 'no questions after dispatch' contract (resolve all clarifications before dispatching sub-agents, give full stop conditions in the prompt) reduces mid-flight stalls and human interruptions.

Observability is a cross-cutting acceptance concern: features shipped without structured logs, a doctor/healthcheck entry point, and failure-query commands generate disproportionate debugging cost later. Making observability an acceptance gate (with recorded exemptions for small fixes) is cheaper than backfilling.

Direction/taste disagreements never converge through findings-union loops; they need a separate route that classifies the disagreement and escalates non-evidence-decidable disputes to a human by default.

hypotheses.text: Running a heterogeneous refute-first spec review (spec-codesign prompt) before implementation lowers the count of HIGH/CRITICAL implementation-stage blockers compared to skipping spec review.
Requiring test-pins as the converge exit condition reduces repeat findings (same invariant re-reported in a later round or later run) compared to fix-without-pin.

An explicit six-gate acceptance checklist (scripts green, artifacts read, audit converged, docs synced, experience captured, observability present) catches incomplete closeouts that exit-code-only acceptance passes.
Docs-drift scans that respect inline drift-ok annotations produce fewer false positives than scans that treat every doc-vs-code mismatch as drift.

anti_patterns.name: skip-spec-straight-to-code
anti_patterns.description: Starting implementation before a reviewed spec exists. The cost shows up as direction churn and rework during converge.

anti_patterns.name: self-audit-instead-of-heterogeneous
anti_patterns.description: Producer and auditor sharing a model family invalidates the implementation audit, regardless of prompt strength.

anti_patterns.name: missing-test-pin
anti_patterns.description: Declaring convergence while audit-raised invariants have no regression test. The invariant silently regresses later.

anti_patterns.name: implementation-done-treated-as-done
anti_patterns.description: Treating 'code complete' as 'task complete', skipping acceptance gates, docs sync, experience capture, and release hygiene.
